environment.description: Apollo GraphQL server running on EKS (Kubernetes 1.28) in namespace 'api-gateway'. Pod runs with default service account. No NetworkPolicy objects applied to the namespace. IMDSv1 is enabled on the EC2 nodes (HttpTokens: optional). The backend gRPC service at backend-svc:50051 proxies requests including metadata-based routing to downstream services, one of which can reach the instance metadata endpoint.
